name: pr-desc-verifier
description: Before Claude runs gh pr create or gh pr edit, shows you the PR's title and description and waits for your approval; reject it with feedback and Claude revises

guardCreate.title: Review gh pr create
guardCreate.description: Ask before Claude opens a pull request with gh pr create (or gh pr new).

guardEdit.title: Review gh pr edit
guardEdit.description: Ask before Claude changes a pull request's title or body with gh pr edit. Edits that only touch labels, reviewers or the base never ask.

guardFill.title: Review --fill PRs
guardFill.description: Ask also when the title and body are auto-filled from commits (--fill, --fill-first, --fill-verbose) and Claude wrote neither.

exemptDrafts.title: Skip draft PRs
exemptDrafts.description: Let gh pr create --draft through without asking.
